snippet.title: Bus Bound - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🚍 Schedule update: 

📢 Bus Bound will arrive in 2026! 🗓🚏

Master the flow of traffic in a dense city environment and build trust with your passengers by safely navigating various on-road obstacles. 🚌⬆️👍

Unlock new routes and American buses as your actions shape and improve the world around you! 💪

Coming to Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S! ⏱️

Wishlist today! ✅
